## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** Worker computes `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) = `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` (thresholds in `worker/src/types/index.ts:175`: 0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000) and `level < 10`. This is returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` and `POST /api/combat/resolve`. UI shows a banner (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and ability picker (`game-console.component.html:19-28`), prompted after combat.

**Trigger → endpoint:**
1. `game-console.component.ts:183` `levelUp(key)` → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`)
2. `POST /api/levelup` (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`) — validates `abilityChoice` ∈ {str,dex,con,int,wis,cha}; 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**What changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- `level` +1
- HP gain = `roll(class hit die) + CON mod`, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6 — `CLASS_HIT_DICE`)
- Chosen ability score **+2** (AC unchanged; scores not capped at 20)

**After:** route generates flavor text (usually fallback, bug B-03), logs a `system` `[Level Up] …` row and DM history turn; frontend (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`) calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows a system message, updates campaign slot level. One level per call — multiple pending levels require repeated calls.
